rules.safety_requirement: must ensure that buffer+length and MaxTextExtent-length describe a valid writable range before FormatLocaleString writes to it
rules.applicable_condition: when FormatLocaleString is called with buffer+length and MaxTextExtent-length inside the component loop
rules.note: Loop and arithmetic facts link the write offset and remaining size to the buffer.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p1+size remains within the allocated buffer before advancing p1
rules.applicable_condition: when p1+=size is executed after the length >= MaxTextExtent-1 guard
rules.note: The guard concerns length, while the pointer advance uses size.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure length-2 is a valid index into buffer before writing buffer[length-2]
rules.applicable_condition: when length > 1 and buffer[length-2] is assigned
rules.note: The length > 1 guard is linked to the indexed write.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure ReadPropertyByte has enough remaining EXIF data before reading and advancing exif
rules.applicable_condition: when the while length != 0 loop calls ReadPropertyByte(&exif,&length)
rules.note: The loop condition and continue guard are linked to the read operation.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif+4 is within the EXIF data before ReadPropertySignedLong reads from it
rules.note: The later offset guard does not guard the read at exif+4.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure directory points to enough EXIF data before ReadPropertyUnsignedShort reads from it
rules.note: directory is derived from exif+offset, but no bound check is linked to this read.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure directory+(12*entry)+2 remains within the EXIF data before q is formed and used
rules.applicable_condition: when entry < number_entries and q is assigned from directory+(12*entry)+2
rules.note: The loop bound and splay-tree check are linked, but no EXIF-size bound is shown.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure components*tag_bytes[format] does not overflow size_t before number_bytes is used for allocation or copying
rules.note: The multiplication result feeds later allocation and copy operations.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure exif+dir_offset remains within the EXIF data before p is formed and dereferenced
rules.note: dir_offset is derived from EXIF data without a linked bound check.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure the result of AcquireQuantumMemory((size_t)number_bytes+1UL,...) is checked for null before value is used
rules.applicable_condition: when value is assigned from AcquireQuantumMemory
rules.note: The allocation result is linked to number_bytes and later use.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p1 points to at least one readable byte before dereferencing *(signed char *)p1
rules.note: p1 is linked to q and p, but no bound check for this dereference is shown.

rules.safety_requirement: must ensure p points to enough EXIF data before ReadPropertySignedLong(endian,p) reads from it
rules.note: The linked cleanup fact does not guard the read from p.
